mapper.select: SELECT R.TARGET_TYPE AS TARGET_TYPE, R.TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, I.ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, I.SEVERITY_CD AS SEVERITY_CD, R.REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_CHECKLIST_RESULT_PILOT R JOIN TB_IF_CHECKLIST_ITEM_PILOT I ON I.CHECKLIST_ID = R.CHECKLIST_ID WHERE R.CHECKED_YN = 'N' AND NVL(I.ACTIVE_YN,'Y') = 'Y'

SELECT TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, HA_YN AS HA_YN, RTO_MINUTES AS RTO_MINUTES, RPO_MINUTES AS RPO_MINUTES FROM TB_IF_AVAIL_PROFILE_PILOT WHERE HA_YN = 'N' OR RTO_MINUTES IS NULL OR RPO_MINUTES IS NULL

SELECT G.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, G.GROUP_NAME AS GROUP_NAME, G.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_SERVER_GROUP_PILOT G WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_IF_CAPACITY_PILOT C WHERE C.TARGET_TYPE_CD = 'GROUP' AND C.TARGET_ID = G.GROUP_ID AND C.METRIC_SCOPE_CD = 'PEAK' )
SELECT PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, STRATEGY_7R_CD AS STRATEGY_7R_CD, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_MIGRATION_PLAN_PILOT WHERE WAVE_ID IS NULL
SELECT GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME AS GROUP_NAME, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, TIER_CD AS TIER_CD FROM TB_IF_SERVER_GROUP_PILOT WHERE STATUS_CD IN ('VALIDATING','DISCOVERED')
